LOGOS · COLOURS · TEMPLATES

Logo & visual style

A recognisable look for your research project, business or band. A logo, colours, fonts and ready-to-use templates, with simple instructions for your team.

What we can make

  • A logo and versions for different uses
  • Colours and fonts
  • A guide to using your logo
  • Presentation and social templates

PROJECT WEBSITES · APPS · CLICKABLE DEMOS

Websites & apps

A place to explain your research, share results or help people use a tool. We design for the person visiting, with clear steps and readable information.

What we can make

  • Page plans and simple sketches
  • Websites that work on phones and computers
  • App screens and clickable demos
  • Reusable designs and files for your developer

CONFERENCES · REPORTS · SOCIAL POSTS

Slides, posters & reports

Turn detailed work into a clear presentation, research poster or report. We organise your approved content and help the key points stand out.

What we can make

  • Conference and research posters
  • Editable presentation and social templates
  • Reports, diagrams and presentation slides
  • Print-ready files and digital versions
Slides & poster toolkit15,000 NOK ↗

MOTION GRAPHICS · 3D · INTERACTION

Animation & explainers

Show how something works, step by step. We turn your explanation into moving diagrams, animated text or a short film, with your team checking the facts.

What we can make

  • Animated logos and text
  • Moving diagrams and research explainers
  • 3D imagery & animation
  • Interactive web experiences
Short animation18,000 NOK ↗

INTERVIEWS · SHORT-FORM · COLOUR GRADING

Video editing & colour

Turn supplied footage into a clear story. We edit interviews and research films, cut shorter versions for social media, add captions and adjust colour so shots look consistent.

What we can make

  • Interview and presentation edits
  • Short-form video for reels and social posts
  • Captions, titles and simple graphics
  • Colour correction, colour grading and audio cleanup
Video edit & short cuts12,000 NOK ↗

SONIC LOGOS · UI SOUNDS · FILM

Sound & sonic branding

A sound of your own: a few notes at the end of a film, a podcast intro or a recognisable sound for your project. That’s sonic branding.

What we can make

  • A short signature sound (sonic logo)
  • Sounds for app actions
  • Sound for animation
  • Original audio for films and podcasts
